scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; finite exact Gram determinant enumeration corroborates identities through order seven, and numerical quadrature checks only the decimal value. Distinct published face combinatorics and probabilistic limit tools are credited. No claim of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern standard coordinate-root Euclidean realizations, not arbitrary lattice equivalent embeddings; the Brownian scaling is for paths and the deterministic comparison for stars. No assertion of global surface-area extremizers or finite-size error bounds. The numerical constant is defined by a convergent exact integral.
title: Facet-area Wiener identity and Brownian surface separation for tree root polytopes
